# Stand-in for the vaults of a secret manager, not part of a normal install.
# Every value here is fake and committed on purpose. A real repo never
# commits a secret: its values live in the secret manager, and the repo
# holds only the references in ci/secret-manager/*.env.
#
# One reference and its value per line, separated by one space.
fake://examples-preview/webhook-api/key FAKE-READ-KEY-not-a-secret
fake://examples-deploy/webhook-api/key FAKE-DEPLOY-KEY-not-a-secret
